description: Read one numbered part of a published MFM document or dataset (an id returned by search that starts with "portfolio:" recomputes the portfolio calculator, nothing stored). Company metadata includes verification_level, audit_id, audit_url and controls_performed. metadata.next_id identifies the following part or is null. Audit levels describe programme membership. Company records: amounts are whole units of the currency stated in each period (field currency), never thousands or millions; ratios in metrics are decimals (0.15 = 15%) except anni_* (years), copertura_interessi, conversione_utili_cassa, investimenti_su_ammortamenti and debito_su_patrimonio* (multiples, 1.5 = 1.5 times). years are in ascending order: the latest fiscal year is the LAST element, in the last parts, so follow every next_id before answering. ttm, quarters and interim_reports are separate periods with their own end dates; use the most recent end date and never annualise. A null metric has its reason in warnings of the same period; an absent key is not zero. Price-based ratios (P/E, market value, dividend yield) are not in the record; public_float is the aggregate market value of shares held by non-affiliates declared on the cover of the annual report (SEC: at the end of the second fiscal quarter), not the current market capitalisation. Descriptive data only: no forecast, no recommendation.

model_id.description: Optional identifier of the model used for the inspection; client-declared, not model attestation.
